teaser: Turning the 49 tools of tools.sgraph.ai into sovereign websites: one site each, simple first, pinned versions, signed hashes, a team of teams.
core_idea: The 49 browser tools built one problem at a time outgrew one repository; as sovereign websites, each gets its own address, documentation, design and agent team, released in waves from the simplest, with shared components versioned, every release pinned beside latest, hashes signed in a separate repository, and a team of teams to change many at once.

quotes.text: if you have a challenge, you might as well build the tool for it.
the compromise shows instead of spreading.
